text: Press Release: FDIC Publishes Enforcement Orders for July 2026 FDIC Subscriptions sent this bulletin at 08/28/2026 10:33 AM EDT PRESS RELEASE | AUGUST 28, 2026 FDIC Publishes Enforcement Orders for July 2026 WASHINGTON—The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) today published a list of orders of administrative enforcement actions taken against banks and individuals in July 2026. There are no administrative hearings scheduled for September 2026. Order Terminating Consent Order: Spring Valley Bank, Wyoming, OH Orders of Prohibition from Further Participation: Aaron T. Luneke, as an institution-affiliated party of Bank of the Valley, Bellwood, NE Brianna Pelosi, as an institution-affiliated party of Truist Bank, Charlotte, NC Kerry Trevell Hancock, as an institution-affiliated party of Northwest Bank, Warren, PA Courtney Mayfield Sitkowski, as an institution-affiliated party of Independent Bank, McKinney, TX July 2026 Enforcement Decisions and Orders # # # MEDIA CONTACT: MediaRequests@fdic.gov The FDIC does not send unsolicited email.
